Management studies in Madrid gave Alegre an international start, followed by early work with CBRE Spain and a co-founding role at Sublime in Comporta. He then joined the family organisation, bringing outside property experience into a business combining design, restaurants, hotels and premium consumer brands.

Alegre has since become involved in Portugal's Next in Line network for younger family-business executives. Its forums examine continuity, innovation and the practical demands of working beside founders and relatives. His contributions have focused on reconciling lessons from Spain with the purpose of a Portuguese luxury company, an operating perspective that now informs his work across new concepts and destinations.
